hook.line: If you're too mean to Claude, they might ban you now.
hook.visual: Extreme close-up of a grinning face on a purple-lit set, word-by-word yellow-highlight captions in the middle; the orange Claude logo pops in above his head at 0.75 s.

beats.what: Very tight face close-up, caption 'IF YOU'RE TOO'
Claude logo card pops in above his head on 'mean to Claude'
Jump cut to a different framing on 'Anthropic just dropped'
Cut; The Verge headline card appears top-left as proof
Cut to medium shot: what you can still do (call it stupid, swear)
Pinching hand gesture on the line that crosses it: bullying it for no reason
Cut on the reason: they don't know if Claude has feelings
Claude logo card returns above his head on 'just in case it does'
Wide-mouthed reaction: 'that's valid', his own opinion
Ends on a wave: 'we're chill, I swear', which loops back to the opening

why_it_works: A surprising, personal bold claim ('they might ban you') in the first 2 s, about a tool the viewer uses
The logo pops in exactly on the word 'Claude', so the topic is clear with sound off
Framing changes on cuts (face height spread 0.235) keep a single-person video moving at 9.4 cuts/min
Short (32 s) with an opinion and a joke ending, so it is easy to finish and rewatch (loop 0.796)
weaknesses: The Verge headline card is small and placed top-left, where it is hard to read
No music or sound effects to mark the logo pops
for_robert: Copy the logo pop above the head on the exact keyword: Fred can pop into that same spot holding the logo on the word, then duck out on the next cut and come back for the second mention.
